properties.name: Organization
properties.description: Exact Cisco Intersight organization containing the source Server Profile Template and target server. The new profile is created in this same organization.

properties.name: Template Name
properties.description: Exact same-organization Server Profile Template name used to derive the new profile.

properties.name: New Profile Name
properties.description: Exact unique name for the new Server Profile. An existing destination returns 409 and is never reused or resumed automatically.

properties.name: Server Name or Serial
properties.description: Only target-server selector. Before any mutation, the read-only identity resolver requires exactly one organization-scoped physical server matching this exact Name or Serial and supplies its validated Moid and concrete type internally.

properties.name: Perform Profile Deployment and Activation
properties.description: When true, performs profile creation, assignment, ordered Deploy then Activate actions, and possible reboot with ProceedOnReboot. Select true only after verifying the exact template, new profile name, and target server.

properties.name: Profile Description
properties.description: Optional description applied to the newly derived Server Profile.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: Terminal workflow status. Any 2xx value means Cisco Intersight accepted the validated Server Profile deploy-and-activate request; completion is not monitored. Validation, lookup, or submission failures return their corresponding 4xx or 5xx status.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Structured submission evidence including exact profile and target identity, request mode, returned action and scheduled actions, immediate configuration state, and retry-safety context. It does not prove deployment or activation completion.

Creates one new Cisco Intersight Server Profile from an exact same-organization template. A read-only identity lookup resolves Server Name or Serial to exactly one organization-permitted Blade or Rack Unit and supplies its validated Moid and concrete type internally. The workflow refuses an existing destination name, waits up to ten minutes for derivation, assigns the resolved target, and submits ordered Deploy then Activate actions. Success means Cisco Intersight accepted the validated deploy-and-activate request; deployment, activation, and association completion are not monitored. Activation can reboot the server. This workflow does not start an operating-system installation. Import the four dependent atomics first and select an authorized intersight.endpoint target.
